Test Steps: Verify Employee A can send a direct message to Employee B
Test Data: 1. Log in as Employee A 2. Open Chat/Messages 3. Search for Employee B 4. Type 'Hello' and hit Send
Date of execution: Message is delivered instantly and appears in the chat thread.

Test Steps: Verify recipient (Employee B) receives real-time notification
Test Data: 1. Log in as Employee B 2. Wait for message from Employee A
Date of execution: Employee B sees an unread badge counter update, and a toast/push notification appears.

Test Steps: Verify validation when attempting to send an empty message
Test Data: 1. Open chat 2. Leave text box blank or just spaces 3. Hit Send
Date of execution: Send button is disabled or system rejects the empty submission.

Test Steps: Verify validation when message exceeds maximum character limit
Test Data: 1. Type a message containing 10,000 characters 2. Hit Send
Date of execution: System blocks sending and shows 'Message exceeds maximum length' error.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can create a new Group Channel
Test Data: 1. Log in as Admin 2. Click 'Create Channel' 3. Name it 'IT Team' 4. Add 3 employees 5. Save
Date of execution: Group channel is created and the 3 added members receive a notification.

Test Steps: Verify members can leave a Group Channel
Test Data: 1. Open a joined channel 2. Click Settings > 'Leave Group'
Date of execution: User is removed from the channel and no longer receives messages.

Test Steps: Verify unauthorized users cannot view private groups
Test Data: 1. Employee A tries to search for a Private Group they aren't invited to
Date of execution: Private group name does not appear in search results for non-members.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can publish a company-wide Announcement
Test Data: 1. Go to Announcements 2. Create 'Holiday Notice' 3. Select 'All Employees' 4. Publish
Date of execution: Announcement is published and appears prominently on everyone's dashboard.

Test Steps: Verify validation when a regular Employee attempts to broadcast
Test Data: 1. Log in as regular Employee 2. Look for 'Create Announcement' button
Date of execution: Button/Feature is hidden or blocked with 'Permission Denied' for non-admins.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can target Announcements to specific Departments
Test Data: 1. Create Announcement 2. Select Audience: 'Sales Dept' 3. Publish
Date of execution: Only employees mapped to the Sales department see the announcement.

Test Steps: Verify Employee can attach and send an image/PDF in chat
Test Data: 1. Open Chat 2. Click Attachment Icon 3. Upload a 2MB PDF 4. Send
Date of execution: File uploads successfully and is downloadable by the receiver.

Test Steps: Verify validation when uploading unsupported/executable file formats
Test Data: 1. Open Chat 2. Upload an executable file (.exe) 3. Send
Date of execution: System rejects upload and prompts 'Only PDF/Image/Word documents are allowed'.

Test Steps: Verify validation when file size exceeds server limit
Test Data: 1. Open Chat 2. Upload a 50MB file (assuming 10MB limit)
Date of execution: System rejects upload with 'File size exceeds maximum limit' error.

Test Steps: Verify offline users receive Email notifications for unread messages
Test Data: 1. Employee A sends message to offline Employee B 2. Check Employee B's email
Date of execution: System dispatches an email summarizing the unread messages after a delay.

Test Steps: Verify Users can search through chat history
Test Data: 1. Open Chat 2. Use Search Bar to search for a specific keyword sent yesterday
Date of execution: System filters and highlights the exact message containing the keyword.

Test Steps: Verify chat history persists across logins
Test Data: 1. Log out 2. Log back in 3. Open Chat
Date of execution: Previous messages are retained and loaded successfully (no data loss).

Test Steps: Verify XSS payload in chat message
Test Data: 1. Send message containing <script>alert('hack')</script>
Date of execution: System sanitizes the message so the script does not execute on receiver's browser.

Test Steps: Verify SQL Injection in Chat Search
Test Data: 1. Enter SQL payload in chat search bar
Date of execution: System handles query safely without leaking database records.

Test Steps: Verify URL Tampering for reading other users' chats
Test Data: 1. Employee A intercepts API request and modifies ConversationID to Employee C's chat
Date of execution: Backend validates user participation and returns '403 Forbidden' error.

Test Steps: Verify malicious links in chat are flagged/unclickable
Test Data: 1. Send a known malicious link or javascript: URL in chat
Date of execution: System sanitizes links or opens them with safety warnings (target=_blank rel=noopener).
